_about: U3630: the table behind «mengder og grov pris» (amounts.mjs). Edit the numbers here; a price with no source is refused at load. The prices are the builder's ROUGH placeholders (NOK ex. VAT, 2026), NOT from a price book or an offer: Morten replaces them with his own and sets the source. Everything priced from them is «antatt».

assumptions.how: A new building: a concrete ground slab (footprint × slab_m); a concrete building also has a slab on each upper storey; walls are perimeter × height × wall_m of the building's material; a glass building's skin (walls and roof, glass_m²) is glass. A pool basin: floor and walls × pool_wall_m of concrete. Earth: m³ dug × soil_t_per_m3 is the tonnes moved.
